ideas.title: Investigation into Federal Agents' Actions
ideas.description: This story would investigate the allegations of potential kidnapping and false imprisonment by federal agents in Ramsey County.
ideas.angle: The specific investigative angle would be to determine the facts surrounding the incident and whether federal agents abused their power.
questions: What are the implications of the investigation?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it involves allegations of abuse of power by federal agents. The investigation will help determine the facts and ensure accountability.

ideas.title: The Business of Billing in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the business of billing in Minnesota, specifically focusing on companies that own and operate multiple companies billing Minnesota Medicaid.
ideas.angle: The specific investigative angle would be to determine the extent of the practice and whether it involves any wrongdoing.
ideas.insight: This story matters because it involves the use of public funds and potential wrongdoing by companies billing Medicaid.
